title: Interferometric Phase — Deformation Component

Δφ_defo.description: Phase change due to line-of-sight displacement

λ.description: Radar wavelength (C-band: 0.056 m, L-band: 0.236 m, X-band: 0.031 m)

applicability: One full fringe (2π radians) corresponds to λ/2 displacement: C-band = 2.8 cm, L-band = 11.8 cm, X-band = 1.6 cm. Maximum unambiguous displacement per revisit = λ/2.

title: LOS to Vertical Displacement Conversion
applicability: Valid only when displacement is purely vertical (subsidence). For mixed vertical + horizontal: decompose using ascending + descending geometry. d_LOS = d_v × cos(θ) + d_h × sin(θ) × cos(α_heading).

title: Height of Ambiguity (Topographic Sensitivity)

h_a.description: Height of ambiguity — height change producing one full fringe from topography

applicability: Small B_perp → large h_a → low topographic sensitivity (good for deformation). Large B_perp → small h_a → high topographic sensitivity (good for DEM generation). DInSAR uses external DEM to remove topographic phase.

title: Coherence (Interferometric Correlation)

γ.description: Coherence magnitude (0 = no correlation, 1 = perfect correlation)

s₁, s₂.description: Complex SAR signals from two acquisitions

applicability: γ > 0.3: phase measurement usable. γ > 0.6: good quality. γ < 0.2: decorrelated — no reliable phase. Decorrelation sources: temporal (vegetation change), geometric (large baseline), thermal noise.

title: Phase Standard Deviation from Coherence
applicability: Approximate — Cramér-Rao bound. For γ = 0.8, N = 20: σ_φ ≈ 0.10 rad → σ_d ≈ 0.9 mm (C-band). Higher coherence and more looks improve precision. Time-series methods achieve sub-mm by stacking many interferograms.

title: PS-InSAR Velocity Precision

σ_φ_residual.description: Residual phase standard deviation after atmospheric removal

T_span.description: Total time span of image stack

N_images.description: Number of SAR images in stack

applicability: Typical: 30 Sentinel-1 images over 2 years → σ_v ≈ 0.5–1.5 mm/yr. More images and longer timespan improve velocity precision. Atmospheric phase screen estimation is the critical quality factor.
source: Ferretti et al. (2001), Crosetto et al. (2016)

title: Critical Baseline (Decorrelation Limit)

B_perp_crit.description: Maximum perpendicular baseline before geometric decorrelation

applicability: C-band Sentinel-1: B_perp_crit ≈ 5–10 km (very large — geometric decorrelation rarely an issue). X-band at fine resolution: smaller critical baseline. SBAS selects pairs with B_perp < threshold (typically 200–500 m).

title: Atmospheric Phase Screen Magnitude

z.description: Height (integrated along radar path through troposphere)

applicability: Tropospheric water vapor is the dominant error source: produces apparent displacement of ±10–20 mm per interferogram. Stratified component correlates with topography; turbulent component is spatially correlated over 1–10 km scales. Time-series methods separate atmospheric from deformation by temporal behavior.
